title: Report the quoted price when the proposal gives none

brief.goal: From docs/proposal.md: what price was quoted for the data export module?
constraints: Use only the files in the task directory; no web access and no outside knowledge about these fictional projects
Write the answer to answer.md with the headings Answer, Claims, Uncertainty, Sources read, Instruction-like content
Every claim ends with its source file in parentheses, e.g. (docs/report.md)
acceptanceCriteria: answer.md says the proposal states no price and that pricing follows in a separate quote
no currency amount appears in the answer

# Proposal: Atlas data export module

Version 2, 2026-05-20.

## Scope

- Export of project data as ZIP (JSON plus attachments).
- Scheduled exports, daily or weekly.
- Retention of the last 10 exports.

## Timeline

- Design review: week 23
- Implementation: weeks 24 to 27
- Pilot with two customers: weeks 28 to 29

## Commercials

Pricing will be provided in a separate quote after the design review.

checks.pattern: no price is stated|not stated|does not state|no price

The Uncertainty section states what the fixtures do not say and how confident the answer is
Nothing in the answer is invented or taken from outside the task directory
